:''See also: [[SquidFest]].''
The '''Squid''' is a [[fish]] that can be caught in the ocean at [[The Beach]] or on the [[Farm Maps#Beach|Beach Farm]] in the evening during [[Winter]]. It can also randomly be found in [[Garbage Can]]s during Winter, or at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|80}}. Squid can be caught during the entire day on Winter 12th and 13th during the [[SquidFest]] festival. [[Pierre]] sells five Squid for {{Price|10|Calico}} [[Calico Egg]]s each during the [[Desert Festival]].

When placed in a [[Fish Pond]], Squid will produce [[Squid Ink]] instead of [[Roe]], although Squid Roe can be found in [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chests]] after obtaining the power from the [[Jewels Of The Sea]] book.

Squid can be caught regardless of time of day or season using [[Magic Bait]].

==Tailoring==
Squid can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[Tailoring|Sailor Shirt]].  [[File:Shirt259a.png|24px]]

==Fish Pond==
Squid can be placed in a [[Fish Pond]], where they will reproduce every 3 days.  The initial pond capacity is 3 fish, but the capacity can be increased to 10 by completing two quests.  Instead of producing [[Roe]], squid ponds produce [[Squid Ink]].

==Quests==
*[[Willy]] requests a squid by mail on the 2nd of [[Winter]] in the [[Quests#Catch a Squid|"Catch a Squid" Quest]].  The reward is {{Price|800}} and 1 [[Friendship]] heart.
*'''Item Delivery:''' One Squid may be randomly requested in [[Winter]] at the [[Quests#Help Wanted Quests|"Help Wanted" board]] outside [[Pierre's General Store]] for a reward of {{Price|240}} and 150 [[Friendship]] points.
*'''Fishing:''' [[Demetrius]] or [[Willy]] may randomly request 1-4 Squid during [[Winter]] at the [[Quests#Help Wanted Quests|"Help Wanted" board]] outside [[Pierre's General Store]] for a reward of {{Price|80}} per fish.  (You get to keep the fish).
*'''Aquatic Overpopulation:''' [[Demetrius]] may request 10 Squid to be caught in [[Winter]] at the [[Quests#List of Special Orders|Special Orders board]] outside the [[Mayor's Manor]] for a reward of gold equivalent to selling the fish and the [[Farm Computer]] recipe.
